name: simple-seo
description: Finds your pages that are closest to more Google clicks, checks one page's on-page SEO against a keyword, then drafts a better title, meta description, H1 and intro for you to review.

interface.shortDescription: Find quick wins, then audit and fix pages
interface.longDescription: Simple SEO has three skills. Quick Wins reads your Google Search Console data through Composio and finds the pages closest to getting more clicks. Page Audit checks one web page against a target keyword and lists its on-page SEO problems, most important first. Page Fix drafts a better title, meta description, H1 and intro for you to review. It never changes your site or Search Console, and it doesn't research competitors or use paid SEO tools.
defaultPrompt: Check the SEO of this page for my target keyword
Fix the title and meta description on this page for my keyword
